value.zh: 昔晉獻公聽驪姬之讒殺申生，三世大亂。
value.en: Long ago, Duke Xian of Jin heeded Li Ji's calumny and executed Crown Prince Shensheng—and three generations of chaos followed.
value.literal: Of old, Duke Xian of Jin listened to Li Ji's slander and killed Shensheng; three generations suffered great disorder.

value.zh: 漢武帝信江充之誣罪戾太子，京城流血。
value.en: Emperor Wu of Han trusted Jiang Chong's fabricated charges against Crown Prince Li, and the capital ran with blood.
value.literal: Emperor Wu of Han believed Jiang Chong's false accusation against the Crown Prince Li, and the capital ran with blood.

value.zh: 晉惠帝用賈後之譖廢愍懷太子，中原塗炭。
value.en: Emperor Hui of Jin acted on Empress Jia's accusations and deposed Crown Prince Minhuai—and the heartland was laid waste.
value.literal: Emperor Hui of Jin took Empress Jia's slander and deposed the Crown Prince Minhuai; the Central Plain was scorched to ruin.

value.zh: 隋文帝納獨孤後之言黜太子勇，立煬帝，遂失天下。
value.en: Emperor Wen of Sui listened to Empress Dugu, set aside Crown Prince Yong, and raised Yang Guang to the throne—and in the end lost the empire.
value.literal: Emperor Wen of Sui accepted Empress Dugu's words, removed Crown Prince Yong, and installed Emperor Yang—thereby losing all under Heaven.

value.en: The lesson of history is plain: such a step demands the utmost caution.
value.literal: Viewed from this, one must be cautious.

value.zh: 陛下必欲爲此，臣不敢奉詔。」
value.en: If Your Majesty insists on this course, I cannot in conscience obey such an order."
value.literal: If Your Majesty must do this, your servant dare not receive the command."

value.zh: 林甫初無所言，退而私謂宦官之貴幸者曰：「此主上家事，何必問外人！」
value.en: Li Linfu said nothing at first. Afterward he took aside a favored eunuch and murmured: "This is a matter for the Son of Heaven's own household. Why consult outsiders at all?"
value.literal: Li Linfu at first said nothing; on retiring he privately told a favored eunuch: "This is the sovereign's household affair—why must outsiders be consulted!"

value.en: The Emperor wavered, unable to settle on a decision.
value.literal: The Emperor hesitated and had not yet decided.

value.zh: 惠妃密使官奴牛貴兒謂九齡曰：「有廢必有興，公爲之援，宰相可長處。」
value.en: Consort Wu Huifei secretly sent her palace attendant Niu Guier to Zhang Jiuling with this offer: "One prince deposed means another raised. Back us, and you can keep your post as chief minister indefinitely."
value.literal: Consort Wu Huifei secretly sent the office slave Niu Guier to tell Zhang Jiuling: "Where there is removal there must be elevation—if you lend support, you may long remain chief minister."

value.en: Zhang Jiuling rebuked the messenger and reported the overture to the Emperor;
value.literal: Zhang Jiuling berated him and reported his words to the Emperor;

value.zh: 上爲之動色，故訖九齡罷相，太子得無動。
value.en: the Emperor's expression changed at the news. From that point until Zhang Jiuling was removed from office, the Crown Prince was left unshaken.
value.literal: the Emperor was moved in countenance on account of this; therefore up until Zhang Jiuling's dismissal from the chief ministership, the Crown Prince remained unmoved.

value.zh: 林甫日夜短九齡於上，上浸疎之。
value.en: Li Linfu daily poisoned the Emperor's mind against Zhang Jiuling, and the Emperor steadily turned away from him.
value.literal: Li Linfu day and night spoke ill of Zhang Jiuling before the Emperor; the Emperor gradually grew distant toward him.
